scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web,ext -c blue,green,magenta "npm -w apps/server run dev" "npm -w apps/web run dev" "npm -w apps/extension run dev"
scripts.share: npm -w apps/web run build && npm -w apps/server run start
scripts.build: npm -w apps/web run build && npm -w apps/extension run build && npm -w apps/oval run build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/server && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web && tsc --noEmit -p apps/extension && tsc --noEmit -p apps/oval
